No Changeover Operation
Change the 'Normal' supply voltage through Variac between 374V to 415V (within 10% of rated voltage). Check the supply should not changeover.

Changeover Operation — Normal → Alternate
Reduce the normal supply voltage through Variac below 331V (below 20% of rated voltage) / switch 'OFF' the 'Normal' supply. ACOS should changeover to 'Alternate' supply and check the O/P is through 'Alternate' supply. (Measure the changeover time)

Changeover Operation — Alternate → Normal
Increase the voltage of 'Normal' supply through Variac above 374V (10% of rated voltage) / Restore the 'Normal' supply and check the supply should switchover to 'Normal' supply. (Measure the changeover time)
⚠ Changeover time must be < 800 mSec

ACOS Trials with System Load
Check the ACOS with system load and ensure proper operation of equipment without power supply interruption while changeover.
Testing by Test Push. Press 'Test push button' (provided on panel) & hold until switch has changed to 'Alternate' supply. On release switch will revert to 'Normal' supply.
Emergency Hand Operation. Check the emergency hand operation in case of remote control / automatic control failure.
